I'm bored waiting in the e.r. and I wanted to share this information with you guys.

Tl:Dr some ass hat decides to harass me for cycling on the road, ends up being arrested at the end of the day. Sweet sweet justice.

I was riding my bike this evening with my girlfriend and on our last stretch home. When a car started honking at us from around 4 car lengths away. This guy pulls up less than a foot away from my gf and is driving right besides us. He proceeds to tell us to get off the fucking road, the road isn't meant for bikes. Mind you, we were in a residential area, single file line with me in the front. He proceeds to drive right next to us for a few yards until I finally told this guy to fuck off. Well this dude didn't like that I said this. He then proceeds to drive faster and starts to turn into us forcing us to get really close to the parked cars. I yelled at my gf to brake hard while I took the time to find an opening in a drive way to get on the side walk. This guy then drives fast and veers off and parks. He then comes out and starts chasing me by foot.tell my girl to book it the opposite direction. He statts Running fill sprint to Catch up to me but I'm on a bike lol. He finally gives up and I can see him run back and tells his daughter who he had in his car to go home. I finally got lost among the streets and somehow found my gf. Phew. We meet up ride for a few minutes thinking we are safe and laughing at how weird the situation was. Glad that it was finally over.

But was I wrong. I hear a loud buzzing coming from behind me. Lo and behold it's the same Damm guy on a red pocket Motor cycle and he's coming straight at me. So to avoid him running straight into me I go on the side walk, well he vaults over the side walk and chases after me, causing me to fall and slam my back really hard on the ground. Guy proceeds to call me a little butch and gets right in my face. He starts saying hit me, im begging you to hit me. And all I could muster up to say was cool red bike, does it come in an adult size? That pissed him off more, which caused him to yell about how "faggoty " I look in my sweet Sohoku kit. He takes off and my body is shaking after hitting myself really hard. I decide to go back to where he parked (which I probably shouldn't have) to take a photo of his car license plate . Luckily , some good Samaritans were walking by and happened to be a neighbor . I asked them if they knew of this guy and they said yes and even gave me his address, they then tell me he has an ankle bracelet. Cool.

Take off to the police station because why not. The officer was super awesome! He took all the info, talked to his supervisor to see where we should take this. I got to do a police line up (just like the shows). He tells me I should go to the e.r. to get my back checked out. And will text me to keep me updated.

I just received the text that the guy is arrested. I'm pressing charges for assault with a deadly weapon. Fuck this guy! He's going to be going back to jail, he couldnt just let me ride my bike and sing the love hime theme song!

Now just waiting for my x-rays...it's been 4 hours. My back hurts :(

Edit: finally being seen by the dr. I have a bruised rib and some really bad bruising on my right side of my back. I'm in a bit of pain and everything feels tight. Just took a percuset, hopefully that will help! My gf also told me that she looked at my bike and my entire rear derailleur is bent. :(

Edit 2: I just woke up not too long ago. Sore and in a bit of pain but none the less pretty good! I'm just glad nothing worse happened to me. Be safe out there guys!
